record.original_question: Jutila proved a Weyl-strength twelfth-moment bound for Hecke-Maass cusp forms of level 1 with spectral parameter at most T. Prove a level-aspect analogue in which one sums over Hecke-Maass cusp forms of level q and bounded spectral parameter.

evidence.quote: Can one prove a level-aspect analogue of this, where one sums over Hecke–Maass cusp forms of level q and bounded spectral parameter?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q \ge 1$ be a positive integer and let $\mathcal{B}_0(q)$ denote an orthonormal Hecke eigenbasis of the space of Hecke–Maass cusp forms for $\Gamma_0(q)$ with bounded spectral parameter (say, with Laplace eigenvalue $1/4 + t_f^2$ satisfying $|t_f| \le 1$). For each such form $f$, let $L(s,f)$ denote its associated $L$-function. Jutila's classical result asserts that, in the level-$1$ setting with spectral parameter at most $T$,
$$\sum_{\substack{f \in \mathcal{B}_0(1) \\ |t_f| \le T}} |L(\tfrac{1}{2}, f)|^{12} \ll_{\varepsilon} T^{4+\varepsilon},$$
which is of Weyl strength (and implies the Weyl-quality subconvex bound $L(1/2,f) \ll t_f^{1/3+\varepsilon}$).

Prove a level-aspect analogue: establish, for any $\varepsilon > 0$, a bound of the form
$$\sum_{f \in \mathcal{B}_0(q),\ |t_f| \le 1} |L(\tfrac{1}{2}, f)|^{12} \ll_{\varepsilon} q^{2+\varepsilon},$$
or, more generally, any bound of Weyl strength in the level aspect summing $|L(1/2,f)|^{12}$ over Hecke–Maass cusp forms of level $q$ and bounded spectral parameter, that yields the Weyl-quality subconvexity exponent $L(1/2, f) \ll q^{1/6+\varepsilon}$ for individual forms.
artifact.status_search_result: A level-aspect twelfth-moment bound of Weyl strength for Hecke–Maass cusp forms of level $q$ with bounded spectral parameter does not appear in the literature. Related work has established a weight-aspect twelfth-moment bound for holomorphic Hecke L-functions and t-aspect Weyl bounds via delta methods, but a full level-aspect twelfth moment of Weyl strength remains, to current knowledge, an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The Twelfth Moment of Hecke L-Functions in the Weight Aspect
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a Weyl-strength twelfth-moment bound in the weight aspect, paralleling Jutila's level-1 spectral-aspect result; level-aspect analogue not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: The weight-aspect analogue has been resolved, but the level-aspect twelfth-moment problem remains separately stated.

status_evidence.title: Weyl bound for GL(2) in t-aspect via a trivial delta method
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes t-aspect Weyl subconvexity for GL(2) L-functions of arbitrary level, but does not prove a level-aspect twelfth moment bound.
status_evidence.claim: Existing level-aspect Weyl subconvex results go through delta methods or spectral reciprocity rather than a twelfth-moment bound.
